name: Reminder
summary: Say when and what with /remind 30m take the bread out, and the channel you set it in is told when it is time.
description: /remind 30m take the bread out sets a reminder for 30 minutes from now (m for minutes, h for hours, d for days, from one minute to 30 days). /reminders lists your own reminders and /unremind 2 cancels one of them by its number; nobody else can see or cancel them. When one comes due, Reminder posts it as Reminder in the channel it was set in, when it comes due, and only where Reminder is allowed to post. Each member can have 5 reminders waiting and a space up to 30, each up to 200 characters. It uses kv.store to remember them, schedule to wake each one at its time, and message.post to say it: an admin approves each when installing. A reminder set before this version has no channel and is still posted in the channel an admin picked. It reads the host's clock (now_ms), so it needs a slim that provides one.

changes: Reminders are now yours alone: /reminders lists and /unremind cancels only the ones you set.
A reminder is posted in the channel it was set in, not in one shared channel.
Each member can have 5 reminders waiting, so one member cannot fill the space.
A reminder no longer stays hidden in a slot the 20-reminder limit still counted.
First release: set, list and cancel reminders, posted to a channel when they come due.
